content:
The production plan summary failed validation because it did not explicitly mention the 'N/A' status for the 5-day step-down week.
The verifier failed with AssertionError: 'Summary must mention the 5-day step-down week'. While the plan correctly identified a transition to 4-day weeks at Week 10, the summary text failed the requirement to include the string 'N/A' when a 5-day week was absent. Avoid omitting specific week identifiers or 'N/A' placeholders in the final three-line summary file, as test_summary_file strictly enforces their presence in the 'Summary:' line.
